message: NEEDS_CHANGES on #2805 delivery scaffolding through exact ee6ae88b8acff12a0acb1bc71cb6b48d93d61290. One-shot runner 31470878586 checks out successfully then fails immediately in Apply reviewed downstream authority-chain payload and skips publication. Source isolates a deterministic self-extraction bug: runner searches outer materializer end token `\n          PY\n` with split(end,1), but the staged payload itself contains nested Python heredocs with the same physical closing `          PY` token, so first-match extraction can truncate the payload before compile/exec. Use a unique outer sentinel/delimiter, or at minimum select/validate the final outer delimiter with rsplit; a checked-in standalone materializer script is cleaner. Also the staged materializer still does not include #2778 KQ_NOTE_ATTRIB vnode custody, so even a successful bot publication would remain incomplete build authority. Temporary runners/triggers/materializer workflows are scaffolding and must leave the final accepted tree. PR review 4904073005. PHYSICAL NO-GO.

data.rootCause: first inner PY heredoc delimiter truncates self-extracted payload
